The issuer demonstrates a solid scale ($3.5B revenue) and a relatively healthy balance sheet with a low debt profile (equity of $1.4B and current ratio above 3.0x), providing short-term financial flexibility. However, operational performance is severely impaired by negative profitability (EBIT of -$216M and Net Income of -$364M), which significantly weakens debt service coverage and signals underlying business model pressures. Balancing the substantial asset/equity buffer against the ongoing operating losses places the credit quality in the speculative-grade range.

DECISION: BB-
